summary:
Status reconciliation is mandatory in canonical work-board and inherited by work-board-coord: observe results, reconcile scoped acceptance/blockers, update Status with guarded native readback, select/admit, dispatch, then update/read back again. Reconcile after worker returns, CI/runtime completion, reviews, supplier replies and accepted closure, and before yield/handoff. Root owns decisions; workers supply evidence. Backlog has no concrete admitted next action; Ready has executable work including capacity waits; In progress requires active accountable execution or a bounded named running operation; In review requires implementation and required validation complete; Blocked has no meaningful action without a named prerequisite/decision; Done requires full scoped acceptance. Update Delivery before whole-promise Outcome. Active child work can make a parent In progress despite blocked portions; one child PR or completed children cannot establish parent In review/Done. Inspection remains read-only. The qualified planning snapshot plus maintained preimage/field-transition guards support one exact native Status effect with finite cooperative writer window, preserved reported schema/views/memberships/unrelated values and independent readback; this is not server CAS or proof of hidden fields. Equal values are no-ops, uncertain effects are readback-only, and Status grants no dispatch, release, retry, weaker acceptance or closure. Periodic freshness is only a backstop. This superseding source instruction record does not establish new published/installed instruction or caller adoption.

Canonical work-board owns shared organization/product coordination, intake, recovery, admission, same-owner execution, scoped acceptance and handoff. Organization binding5/schema3/inspection3/integrator2 and separately qualified product binding3 retain distinct executing-caller and provenance boundaries. Loading skills, linked children, view filters, Observation Verified or source publication grants no scheduling/effect authority. Fresh native membership and exact owner/body/plan/action/PR/head/touch-set/intake/resource/reservation joins remain determining facts; scoped Unknowns fence their affected effects rather than all unrelated work.

Outcome and Delivery classification is explicit. Native parent/direct-child completeness and hierarchy digests cannot be fabricated from titles, leaves, Status or incomplete reads. Six-field current-work parsing retains bounded Owner, Done when, Current deliverable, Next action, Blocked on and Acceptance evidence. Continue an unambiguous original owner/branch/PR/attempt. Source delivery, publication, installed discovery/caller qualification, consumer effects and full native acceptance remain separate. Native Completed differs from not planned or duplicate; all children closed, merged source or healthy inspection cannot satisfy undecomposed parent acceptance. No automatic legacy parent climb or duplicate status/closure ledger is introduced.

The maintained typed migration route supports explicit field/absent-classification/view plans with authenticated scope and independently correlated readback. Membership is not protected enrollment. Preserve existing views, layout, grouping/sorting, field identities/options and unrelated values; unexpected populated preimages or uncertain sends refuse/reconcile without replay. Private enrollment payload/nonce and public commitment use the canonical constructor and separately reviewed protected delivery/current anchor; they remain outside Atlas. Actual installed and runtime-selected instructions need their own identity/readback, not an inferred global selector.

Driver/Kit dependency closure, both native skill roots, manifests, source materialization and consumer routing retain their normal exact-source validation. Accepted historical source/cutover records and all original failures remain in predecessor versions/cited source. This instruction update does not publish a coherent successor, migrate a field/cohort, activate a new runtime or establish economic benefit. Missing historical receipts stay unavailable;439 inherited and46 later original uncertain effects remain distinct/unreleased. Capture source knowledge without importing logs, bulk reports, credentials or runtime assets.
title: Canonical coordinator, scoped acceptance and mandatory root Status reconciliation
